notes.title: Major update 0.29M
notes.content:
We want to thank you, players. Thank you for playing the game while it is in Early Access! Thanks to you, the game is getting better!

We have done a lot in this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629181/ee00e2672fbb82d60bcb76f8225528e26bb6c82e.png[/img]

1. Forest Map Update:
[list]
  [*] We optimized the map, thereby increasing performance. On our computers, the frame rate has doubled.
  [*] We also increased the size of the map.
  [*] Now the player cannot fall off the map.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629181/5ede1f33d4dbb3b945fbf5379f10c39911aa93fb.jpg[/img]

2. Updated Interface:
[list]
  [*] New icons for buttons.
  [*] New sprites for items in the inventory.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629181/2d7bab15aa2bdc7c08e3a96c5c13539809e7a783.jpg[/img]

3. Added Collectible Items:

Now, exploring the game world, the player can find collectible toys. By examining the item in the inventory, you can learn a little story about the item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629181/de4c61e6ab403dfd62ee39f2d86382ceebca2d2d.jpg[/img]

4. Fixed graphical artifacts:
[list]
  [*] The mirror showed red unrendered parts at a certain angle.
  [*] The ghost of the vine no longer loses its color when the angle of view changes.
  [*] Improved animation for Maria.
  [*] Fixed lighting errors in the forest.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629181/e18097e34dbe96b23cfb0a1548c893b09f1f81ff.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.28B
notes.content:
Hello gamers!

We are excited to present you with the new version of the game [b]0.28B[/b]! In this new update, we have fixed bugs and optimized the game! The Forest location now runs much more smoothly. Thank you for being with us.

List of updates:

[list]
[*] Fixed mirror in last scene
[*] Fixed wolf animation
[*] Fixed dialog camera
[*] Fixed skip in dialog when open pause
[*] Fixed demons spawning in forest
[*] Fixed drop from location in Forest
[/list]

notes.title: Major update 0.27L
notes.content:
Hello, dear gamers! Today, we are pleased to present to you our first major update!

In this update, we fixed bugs and expanded the game!

One of the main updates is the correction of the lighting. Now the picture has become more realistic and darker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629181/6067e00adc767b297d9afad0cbd09fc555c1d46a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629181/71a7736ff29a8d6504bef93506d03a227bff7842.png[/img]

[b]Inventory:[/b]

Now you have the opportunity to inspect an item and read its description. Also, used keys are now marked with a checkmark.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629181/cdb25ecfa2348f9281ffffc362ea8b26785f5fed.jpg[/img]

[b]Door Interface:[/b]

Now, approaching a door, you can see whether it is closed or open, as well as the door's name, which helps understand which key is needed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629181/d2b659c003f33293649eb29677ee477239a83fe5.png[/img]

[b]New Mini-Game:[/b]

After completing the first quest in the first location, you will encounter a mini-game. We recommend familiarizing yourself with it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629181/35739f677f66b0c06744c68a729a8eec22d43e57.png[/img]

[b]Search Assistance Wave:[/b]

If searching for items caught you off guard, after some time, items will emit waves that will be visible through walls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629181/5802d100d1e7e2ed362a1e409c2fffad4976a64d.jpg[/img]

New Ghost:[/b]

Now, in addition to wandering shadows, there are shadows whose goal is to extinguish the light.


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Fixed an issue with lingering text after a dialogue.
[*]Fixed brightness.
[*]Fixed the appearance of the main heroine in a jacket.
[/olist]

notes.title: 🎮 Exciting Game Update in the Works! 🎮
notes.content:
Hey there, fellow gamers! We wanted to give you a sneak peek into what we've been cooking up behind the scenes. Our game development team has been hard at work to make your gaming experience even more thrilling and immersive. Here's a little taste of what's on the horizon:

[olist]
[*] Revamped Interface: We're polishing up our existing interface to ensure it's sleek, user-friendly, and a visual treat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629181/ebdccf3315acd8e345033e7cfbcdb7c9ca6bc4d0.jpg[/img]


[*] Interactive Inventory: Get ready for an inventory system that's going to add depth to your in-game experience. Objects and their descriptions will come to life!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44629181/d3aa631f502348c4b38e37e9fa7b2cf25a5e2a52.jpg[/img]
[*] Read All the Notes: Dive deeper into the game's lore and story with the ability to read all the notes you find right in your inventory.

[*] Collectibles Galore: There will be hidden treasures and collectibles throughout the game, each with its own unique description. You can even rotate them to get a better look!

[*] More Thrills: Brace yourself for even scarier moments as we introduce more monsters and spine-tingling experiences.

[*] New Voice: We're introducing a new character with their own voice recordings to add another layer of immersion to the game's story.
[/olist]

We're thrilled to be working on these exciting additions, and we can't wait to share them with you. While we're not quite ready for an official release just yet, rest assured that we're pouring our hearts and souls into making this the best gaming experience possible. Stay tuned for more updates and sneak peeks in the coming weeks!

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. The game is shaping up to be something special, and it's all thanks to you, our fantastic gaming community. 💪🎮
